prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.5 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.7 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.1 °C (59% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.64 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy). A small switching delay appears during the main pressure transient, reflecting early valve degradation.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.31 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 789 W·min/l (106% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.9 % (47% below healthy). Minor drop in delivered flow relative to motor power indicates early internal pump leakage.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.8 bar (22% above healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
